description: This is a C# source file defining the FavoritesController class, which manages 'favorite' actions for articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It contains methods for adding and deleting favorites, incorporating authorization and routing attributes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller handling favorite/unfavorite actions on articles, utilizing MediatR for command dispatching, with route annotations for HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add an article to favorites, identified by slug, using MediatR to send an add command.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article from favorites, identified by slug, using MediatR to send a delete command.
